meta.note: Snapshot (owner ruling Nov 19, 2026: SHIP NOW, community reviews later). Every shipped key is the baseline, so the release gate measures only keys that change AFTER this snapshot. A key missing from a locale is snapshotted at its English hash — its shipped rendering is the English fallback (e.g. the 'Improve this translation' link, design §1.1). A stale entry is NOT snapshotted and counts as new/changed immediately. This is the one-time waiver for the initial machine-translation ship; it does not exempt later changes.
